defect: two independently synchronised state bits reconverge into a decoded state

mutation.description: A changing two-bit state is synchronised one bit at a time and decoded as one coherent value in the destination domain.

rationale: The source can change both state bits together, but their separate synchronizer paths can settle on different cycles and transiently create the decoded 11 state.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Arbitrary two-bit source state is synchronized independently and then decoded as a coherent state; bit skew can create a mixed state.
